title: Count missed selected updates in the actual path residual
statement: The opposed gate gives an exact current-difference coboundary and kinetic-independent stall under its actual force/productive-cycle contract. With faults use r_e=d1-d2-Delta(-u/2), so |J1-J2|<=1+sum|r_e|. For disjoint unit-event classes this is1+2N_wrong_and_flipped+N_missed+N_extra_bit. Two correct-sign channel1events with a stuck bit violate the old displayed count that omitted missed updates. General simultaneous/misobserved events need their actual residual, not these simplified counts. This is established tight-coupling machinery, not a new thermodynamic principle or sensor.
